---
title: "Technical overview of the whole TAF process"
order: 5
---



```{mermaid}
flowchart LR

    %% USERS

    Scientist["Stock Assessors<br/>Scientists"]

    Reviewer[Reviewers]

    Stakeholder["Customers<br/>Stakeholders"]



    %% SOURCE CONTROL

    subgraph GitHub
        Repo[TAF Assessment Repositories]
    end



    %% INGESTION

    subgraph Repository_Management
        Sync[Repository Synchronisation Service]
        Storage["Repository Storage<br/>File System or Azure Blob Storage"]
    end



    %% PROCESSING

    subgraph Processing_Platform

        Validation["Validation Service<br/>TAF Structure & Standards Checks"]

        Execute["Execution Service<br/>Run Assessment Workflow"]

        Runtime["Container Runtime<br/>Docker / Azure Containers"]

    end



    %% DATA

    subgraph Data_Platform

        Metadata["(Metadata Database)"]

        Outputs["(Assessment Outputs)"]

    end



    %% WEB APPLICATIONS

    subgraph User_Services

        Angular[Angular Portal]

        API[ASP.NET Core API]

        Explorer["TAF Explorer<br/>R Shiny"]

    end



    %% REPOSITORY LIFECYCLE

    Scientist --> Repo

    Repo --> Sync

    Sync --> Storage

    Storage --> Validation

    Storage --> Execute

    Execute --> Runtime



    %% VALIDATION

    Validation -->|Validation Status| Metadata



    %% EXECUTION

    Execute -->|Run Metadata| Metadata

    Execute -->|Plots| Outputs
    Execute -->|Tables| Outputs
    Execute -->|PDF Reports| Outputs
    Execute -->|Derived Data| Outputs



    %% PORTAL

    Scientist --> Angular
    Reviewer --> Angular

    Angular --> API

    API --> Metadata
    API --> Outputs



    %% EXPLORER

    Stakeholder --> Explorer

    Explorer --> Metadata
    Explorer --> Outputs



    %% EXPLORER CONTENT

    Explorer --- InputData[Input Data]
    Explorer --- ModelDiag[Model Diagnostics]
    Explorer --- ForecastDiag[Forecast Diagnostics]
    Explorer --- QualityChecks[Quality Checks]



    %% METADATA CONTENT

    Metadata --- RepoURL[GitHub URL]
    Metadata --- RepoPath[Repository Location]
    Metadata --- Species[Species Code]
    Metadata --- Year[Assessment Year]
    Metadata --- ValidationState[Validation Status]
```
